row.notes: In-car driver actor frame update, slot 38 of its vtable 0x14561b650 (cell 0x14561b780, the only ref). Per viewport it shows or hides the driver mesh nodes by name through vcall +0xb8 (gloves_x, body_incar_x, suit_attachments_x, visor_x, visor_tear_x, visor_attachments_x, helmet_, eyes_x, face_balaclava(_v2)_x, balaclava(_v2)_x, harness_x, hans_device_x, harness_classic_x) from camera-settings byte +0x30 and the 'WritableCamera' component; looks up the 'halo' node (Ne_NameRegistry_FindId(0x7c97c1e9)) and copies its rest transform back or writes a zero 3x4 transform; this+0x1b0c is set to 1 here when ctx+0x38 != 0 (no other setter seen). Then samples the clip players (Ne_AnimClipPlayer_Sample_Thunk 0x1403a6400), evaluates the anim layers via Game_InCarDriver_EvaluateAnimLayers (0x1403a33a0) and stores its result at +0x1acc. Better name: Game_InCarDriver_UpdateFrame. Used by vmknolle dukati-lean (rider pose).
